label: Tick Bus
description: Demo node standing in for a streaming producer (an LLM stream): opens a bus, sends three text deltas, closes it. Starts when `start` arrives.

inputs.name: start
inputs.description: Any value; what starts the producer (a route's path).

outputs.name: ticks
outputs.description: Three `delta` messages: t1, t2, t3, then the bus closes.
